title: A right click on decade's chrome opens a menu for the thing under the pointer
body:
decade has no right-click menu. Every action on a pane, tab or workspace is a keybind, a button on a pane's Ctrl bar, or a click in the sidebar or the top bar. A right click goes to the client under the pointer.

## Proposal

A right click on decade's own chrome opens a menu of the actions for the thing under the pointer:

- on a pane's bar or outline: rename, pin, zoom, mark as scratch, accept screenshots
- on a tab's pill: rename, close
- on a workspace's card or tile in the sidebar: rename

A right click inside a client's area still goes to the client. A click outside the menu or Escape dismisses it.

## Open

- Whether the menu is part of the UI kit under milestone decade-4a4e0f, since it draws in the kit's scene and takes the kit's input.
- Whether a keybind opens the same menu for the focused pane.
close_reason: Landed in 8aeb8d6: a right click on decade's chrome opens a context menu with pin, zoom, mark as scratch and clear. Rename joined in 9c9668c.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/7403d304
notes.text:
Jack approved this design:

- A right click on decade's chrome opens a menu at the pointer, drawn like the sidebar popover and kept on screen. The chrome covers a pane's bar or outline, a tab pill, a workspace card or tile, and empty sidebar space. A right click inside a client's area still goes to the client.
- A pane's menu offers pin, zoom and mark as scratch, each labelled for what a click does (pin or unpin). A card or tile offers clear when its agent is done or needs attention. Rename (decade-e8cf5c), new group (decade-316e42) and accept screenshots (decade-6f4db4) join as those land. A place with no entries opens no menu.
- No entry closes a pane: a pane closes only through its x or when its program exits.
- Up, Down, Enter and Escape work in the open menu, and a click outside dismisses it. No keybind opens it.
- The menu lives with decade's own widgets beside the palette and imports nothing from smithay, so it can move into the UI kit (decade-4a4e0f) later.
